configurations.name: koliani-web
runtimeArgs: import os,functools,http.server as h,socketserver as s;s.ThreadingTCPServer.allow_reuse_address=True;port=int(os.environ.get('PORT','8060'));srv=s.ThreadingTCPServer(('',port),functools.partial(h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler,directory='build/web'));print('koliani-web: a servir build/web em http://localhost:%d/' % srv.server_address[1]);srv.serve_forever()
